arena: [생존기] With Overpowered Barrier, Prismatic Barrier absorbs 60% more but lasts only 4 sec, and when fully consumed you gain Time Warp for 6 sec. Pop it the moment the enemy pops their burst cooldowns.

[생존기] Alter Time returns you to the position and health you had when you cast it when pressed again or after 10 sec. Activate it before the burst starts and press it again when your health takes a big hit.
[생존기] Ice Block prevents all attacks and damage for 10 sec, but you can't attack, move or cast meanwhile. Use it when you take burst with other defensives down.
[회피] Blink teleports you 20 yds forward and frees you from all stuns and roots. When a melee DPS stuns you, get out immediately and gain distance.
[위치] With Chrono Shift, Arcane Barrage slows the enemy by 50% and increases your movement speed by 10% for 5 sec. When melee DPS get on you, hit Arcane Barrage and gain distance.
[차단] Counterspell interrupts a cast and locks that school for 7 sec. Save it for the enemy healer's heals.
[제어] Polymorph incapacitates the target for 1 min but damage breaks it. Put it on the enemy healer and meanwhile apply Touch of the Magi to another target with your team to burst.
[해제] Spellsteal steals one beneficial magic effect from the target. Take the enemy's magic buffs or protection effects.
bg: [참고] On flag maps, if a healer can't carry, a mobile DPS carries. When you have the flag, break stuns and roots with Blink and shake chasers with the slow from Arcane Barrage via Chrono Shift.
[제어] With Ice Wall, a 30 yd wall blocks line of sight for up to 15 sec. Cut line of sight for enemies chasing your carrier or for the enemy healer.

[분담] With Improved Mass Invisibility, Mass Invisibility also affects allies in combat within 40 yds, making them invisible for 12 sec. When losing a teamfight, pull your team out and move to the next base.
[제어] Ring of Frost places a ring for 10 sec that incapacitates up to 10 enemies entering it for 10 sec. Drop it next to the base flag you're guarding to lock down enemies coming to capture.
[생존기] Healing taken is reduced by 20% in battlegrounds. Rather than waiting on heals, use Prismatic Barrier and Alter Time right before the burst.
[해제] Remove Curse removes all curses from an ally. Cleanse curses on your carrier or healer first.
pvpTalents: Overpowered Barrier, picked by 36 of the top 38 Solo Shuffle players, increases barrier absorbs by 60% but lasts only 4 sec, and grants Time Warp for 6 sec when Prismatic Barrier is fully consumed. Chrono Shift, picked by 33 of 38 Solo Shuffle and 34 of 43 Battleground Blitz players, adds a 50% slow and a 10% movement speed boost for you to Arcane Barrage. Improved Mass Invisibility, picked by 27 of 38 Solo Shuffle players, reduces Mass Invisibility's cooldown by 3 min and lets it affect allies in combat.

113724.m: Talent · 8% of base mana · 30 yd range · 2 sec cast · 45 sec cooldown
113724.d:
Summons a Ring of Frost for 10 sec at the target location. Enemies entering the ring are incapacitated for 10 sec. Limit 10 targets.

When the incapacitate expires, enemies are slowed by 65% for 4 sec.

235711.d: Arcane Barrage slows enemies by 50% and increases your movement speed by 10% for 5 sec.

352278.m: Tank Specs – Row 1 PvP Talent · 8% of base mana · 30 yd range · 1.5 sec cast · 1.5 min cooldown
352278.d: Conjures an Ice Wall 30 yards long that obstructs line of sight. The wall has 30% of your maximum health and lasts up to 15 sec.

414664.m: Talent · 6% of base mana · Instant · 5 min cooldown
414664.d:
You and your allies within 40 yards instantly become invisible for 12 sec. Taking any action will cancel the effect.

Does not affect allies in combat.

415945.d: The cooldown of Mass Invisibility is reduced by 3 min and it can affect allies in combat.

113724.m: 특성 · 8% (기본 마나 중) · 30 야드 사정거리 · 2 초 주문 시전 시간 · 45 초 재사용 대기시간
113724.d:
10초 동안 대상 지역에 서리 고리를 소환합니다. 고리를 밟는 적은 10초 동안 행동 불가 상태가 됩니다. 최대 10명의 대상에 영향을 줍니다.

행동 불가 효과가 만료되면 4초 동안 적의 이동 속도가 65%만큼 감소합니다.

235711.d: 비전 탄막이 5초 동안 적을 50%만큼 감속시키고, 자신의 이동 속도를 10%만큼 증가시킵니다.

352278.m: 탱커 스펙 – 1열 PvP 특성 · 8% (기본 마나 중) · 30 야드 사정거리 · 1.5 초 주문 시전 시간 · 1.5 분 재사용 대기시간
352278.d: 시야를 가리는 30미터 길이의 얼음 벽을 생성합니다. 벽은 자신의 최대 생명력의 30%에 해당하는 생명력을 가지며, 최대 15초 동안 지속됩니다.

414664.m: 특성 · 6% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 5 분 재사용 대기시간
414664.d:
자신과 40미터 내의 아군이 즉시 12초 동안 투명 상태가 됩니다. 행동을 취하면 효과가 사라집니다.

전투 중인 아군에게는 영향을 주지 않습니다.

415945.d: 대규모 투명화의 재사용 대기시간이 3분만큼 감소하고 전투 중인 아군에게도 영향을 줍니다.
